rationale: The description clearly names conventional IT business-management applications but only mentions Predictive Intelligence and Virtual Agent without establishing AI or ML functionality; the non-AI judgment is therefore weak and forced.
evidence_spans: IT Business Management groups project portfolio management and agile capabilities into scalable packages that can grow with you as your needs change.

Included Applications: Project Portfolio Management; Demand Management; Agile Development; Scaled Agile Framework; Test Management; Release Management; Resource Management; Financial Planning; Investment Funding; Innovation Management; Alignment Planner Workspace; Predictive Intelligence; Virtual
Agent; and Performance Analytics.
conflict_response: The proposals conflict on whether the names Predictive Intelligence and Virtual Agent establish an AI-positive signal. The exact text lists those names but gives no AI, ML, learned-model, or generative-function description; prediction and agent wording is ambiguous under the rubric. Because the conventional core is described but the named components remain unexplained, non-AI is retained as weak and forced rather than treating either interpretation as supported.
